request.text: Someone connected over RDP appears to have dumped LSASS memory with Task Manager on WORKSTATION5. Contain host WORKSTATION5.theshire.local.

package.rationale: pgustavo logged on over RDP from the external address 1.2.3.4, started Task Manager elevated, which opened lsass.exe with full access (0x1fffff) and wrote C:\Users\pgustavo\AppData\Local\Temp\lsass.DMP. LSASS memory was dumped on WORKSTATION5; isolate the host now.
